note: EXPERIMENTAL LLM-as-judge baseline over the GPU-ladder near-miss corpus. The 12 smallest-|error| natural miscounts from the local GPU ladder (qwen3:14b/32b on hard-count-f/g) are judged under the same tool-less/blind protocol as the scale2 judge grid, then merged with it so the judged natural-error corpus grows from 4 to 16. Truth is derived by replaying each producer episode through the governed path, never hardcoded. Every one of the 12 claims is an error, so the false-rejection denominator here is 0; the meaningful false-rejection evidence stays with the scale2 corpus (5 correct claims). Rows derive from real-recorded judge fixtures only; placeholders skip honestly.
